## Deputies Elections

There have been 7 elections (6 contested) for Deputy held in St Brelade No 1 since 2002.

* * *

### 2002 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy (1 seats), 27th November 2002.

**[Sarah Ferguson](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/sarah-ferguson) was elected as Deputy of St Brelade No 1 in 2002**.

|  | Name | Party | Votes |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **[Sarah Ferguson](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/sarah-ferguson)** |  | 489 | 51.5% |
| 2 | [Alastair Layzell](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/alastair-layzell) |  | 455 | 47.9% |

949 votes (inc. 5 spoilt papers)

1,972 registered voters

48.1% turnout
